limitations.note: The agent correctly clocked the counter but also removed the original `ready_b` condition for loading the first value, so an accepted first beat with `ready_b` low overwrites `data_out` instead of adding to it.

The scoreboard assumed each group started from zero regardless of `ready_b` and checked `data_out` only while an output was pending, so it validated the rewrite rather than checking the preserved accumulator behavior.
